نتعامل (form VI)
# نَتَعَامَلُ (nataʕāmalu) /na.ta.ʕaː.ma.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَامَلَ (taʕāmala)
# نَتَعَامَلَ (nataʕāmala) /na.ta.ʕaː.ma.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَامَلَ (taʕāmala)
# نَتَعَامَلْ (nataʕāmal) /na.ta.ʕaː.mal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَامَلَ (taʕāmala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
